title: NewsSource
description: A news source or publisher available through the NewsAPI

id.description: The identifier of the news source. Use with other endpoints.

name.description: The name of the news source.

description.description: A description of the news source.
description.example: The latest technology news and information on startups, money, mobile, security, gadgets, and more.

url.description: The URL of the news source homepage.

category.description: The type of news to expect from this news source.

language.description: The language that this news source writes in (ISO-639-1 code).

country.description: The country this news source is based in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).
